preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 3000.
The number of columns n in the grid must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of white cells in the first and second rows must be between 0 and n.
The number of white and black dominoes must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any((w <= (k1 + k2) // 2) and (b <= (2 * n - k1 - k2) // 2) for _ in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, it must be possible to place all white and black dominoes based on the available white and black cells.
